existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased mitochondrial ATP production is the same decreased-ATP process as the group members, with a mitochondrial context qualifier.
Increase in inflammation, same process as the general and tissue-specific inflammation events in the group.
Altered larval development is the same developmental process as the impaired larval/general development events.
Triglyceride accumulation is the same increased-triglyceride endpoint as the group members.

new_groups.rationale: Increased reactive oxygen species and peptide oxidation are not synonyms, but both are oxidative events at different levels of specificity.
